title: Belum gajian
doc_title: Sinar Multifinance (DEMO) - Panduan Panggilan Pengingat Angsuran
content: Kami mengerti kondisinya. Denda 0,2% per hari berlaku sejak 1 hari setelah jatuh tempo, jadi semakin cepat dibayar, semakin kecil dendanya. Boleh kami catat tanggal rencana pembayarannya?

title: Dendanya kok besar
doc_title: Sinar Multifinance (DEMO) - Panduan Panggilan Pengingat Angsuran
content: Denda dihitung 0,2% per hari dari angsuran yang tertunggak, sesuai perjanjian pembiayaan. Contohnya, angsuran Rp850.000 yang terlambat 5 hari dendanya Rp8.500.

title: Lagi kena musibah / di-PHK / sakit
doc_title: Sinar Multifinance (DEMO) - Panduan Panggilan Pengingat Angsuran
content: Kami turut prihatin. Pelanggan dapat mengajukan restrukturisasi melalui kantor cabang atau layanan pelanggan dengan dokumen pendukung. Pengajuan akan ditinjau oleh tim, dan hasilnya belum bisa dipastikan lewat telepon ini.

title: Motornya rusak atau sudah dijual
doc_title: Sinar Multifinance (DEMO) - Panduan Panggilan Pengingat Angsuran
content: Kewajiban angsuran tetap berjalan sesuai perjanjian. Pengalihan kendaraan ke pihak lain tanpa persetujuan tertulis Sinar Multifinance melanggar perjanjian, jadi mohon hubungi layanan pelanggan.

title: Eskalasi ke petugas
doc_title: Sinar Multifinance (DEMO) - Panduan Panggilan Pengingat Angsuran
content: Layanan pelanggan Sinar dapat dihubungi di 1500-777 (DEMO), Senin-Sabtu pukul 08.00-20.00 WIB.

title: Etika penagihan (wajib)
doc_title: Sinar Multifinance (DEMO) - Panduan Panggilan Pengingat Angsuran
content: Tidak boleh mengancam, mempermalukan, atau menggunakan kata-kata kasar. ; Panggilan hanya dilakukan pukul 08.00-20.00 waktu setempat. ; Tidak membahas utang pelanggan dengan pihak ketiga. ; Jika informasi tidak tersedia, sampaikan dengan jujur dan tawarkan petugas.

title: Berapa DP dan tenor yang tersedia
doc_title: Pertanyaan Umum Pembiayaan Motor
content: Uang muka (DP) minimal 15% dari harga motor. Tenor pembiayaan tersedia 6, 12, 18, 24, 30 dan 36 bulan.

title: Kapan angsuran jatuh tempo
doc_title: Pertanyaan Umum Pembiayaan Motor
content: Tanggal jatuh tempo angsuran tercantum di perjanjian pembiayaan dan kartu angsuran. Sinar Multifinance mengirim pengingat 3 hari sebelum jatuh tempo (H-3) melalui SMS, WhatsApp resmi, atau telepon.

title: Berapa denda keterlambatan
doc_title: Pertanyaan Umum Pembiayaan Motor
content: Denda keterlambatan adalah 0,2% per hari dari angsuran yang tertunggak, dihitung mulai 1 hari setelah tanggal jatuh tempo. Tidak ada masa tenggang.

title: Bagaimana cara membayar cicilan
doc_title: Pertanyaan Umum Pembiayaan Motor
content: Cicilan dapat dibayar melalui virtual account BCA, BRI atau Mandiri, di gerai Indomaret atau Alfamart, atau melalui aplikasi Sinar Mobile. Pembayaran melalui gerai ritel dikenakan biaya admin Rp2.500. Petugas Sinar tidak pernah meminta transfer ke rekening pribadi.

title: Saya sudah bayar, kenapa masih ditagih
doc_title: Pertanyaan Umum Pembiayaan Motor
content: Pembayaran melalui virtual account biasanya tercatat dalam 1x24 jam, dan pembayaran melalui gerai ritel dalam 2x24 jam. Simpan bukti pembayaran. Jika setelah itu status belum berubah, hubungi layanan pelanggan dengan menyertakan bukti bayar.

title: Apakah bisa pelunasan dipercepat
doc_title: Pertanyaan Umum Pembiayaan Motor
content: Bisa. Pelunasan dipercepat dapat diajukan kapan saja dengan biaya administrasi 3% dari sisa pokok pembiayaan.

title: The interest rate is too high
doc_title: Kosha Capital - Business Loan Objection Handling Playbook (internal)
content: I understand the rate matters. Our rates are risk-based and start at 14% per annum on a reducing balance, and no collateral is required. You will see the full cost in the Key Fact Statement before you sign, so you can compare offers. We cannot promise a specific rate before the credit assessment.

title: I don't want to share my documents
doc_title: Kosha Capital - Business Loan Objection Handling Playbook (internal)
content: That is a fair concern. Your documents are used only for KYC and credit assessment, stored in encrypted form, and shared only with credit bureaus and regulators as required by law. You can stop the application at any time.

title: I need time to think
doc_title: Kosha Capital - Business Loan Objection Handling Playbook (internal)
content: Of course, take your time. I can schedule a callback with a relationship manager at a time that suits you, with no obligation.

title: I am worried about hidden charges
doc_title: Kosha Capital - Business Loan Objection Handling Playbook (internal)
content: There are no hidden charges. Every charge is listed in the Key Fact Statement before you sign. The processing fee is up to 2% plus GST, and foreclosure costs 4% of the outstanding principal after 6 EMIs.

title: My credit score is low
doc_title: Kosha Capital - Business Loan Objection Handling Playbook (internal)
content: Applicants need a credit score of at least 700. If your score is lower today, you can reapply after building a stronger repayment record.

title: I already have a loan
doc_title: Kosha Capital - Business Loan Objection Handling Playbook (internal)
content: Having an existing loan does not automatically disqualify you. Your current EMIs are considered when we assess repayment capacity. We do not offer balance transfer or debt consolidation.

title: Compliance rules for agents and bots
doc_title: Kosha Capital - Business Loan Objection Handling Playbook (internal)
content: Never guarantee approval, a specific interest rate, or a disbursal date. ; Always disclose that the final decision is subject to credit assessment. ; Offer a human relationship manager whenever the customer asks for one. ; If information is not in approved material, say so and offer a callback. Do not guess.

title: Branch Partnership Benefits
doc_title: Branch Partnership Program
content: Operational, marketing, and technology support is provided to branch partners. Partners receive co-branded marketing material, access to the Kosha partner portal for lead tracking, and training for their staff.

title: Partner Commission
doc_title: Branch Partnership Program
content: Branch partners earn a payout of 1% to 1.5% of the disbursed loan amount for every referred business loan that is disbursed. Payouts are settled monthly.

title: Who Can Become a Partner
doc_title: Branch Partnership Program
content: Chartered accountants, DSAs, business correspondents and established local financial service firms with at least 2 years of operating history can apply to become branch partners.

title: Loan Amount and Tenure
doc_title: Kosha Business Growth Loan
content: The Kosha Business Growth Loan is an unsecured term loan for MSMEs, proprietors, partnership firms and private limited companies. Loan amounts range from Rs. 1,00,000 (1 lakh) to Rs. 50,00,000 (50 lakh). Repayment tenure ranges from 12 to 60 months, repaid through fixed monthly instalments.

title: Interest Rate
doc_title: Kosha Business Growth Loan
content: Interest rates range from 14% to 24% per annum on a reducing-balance basis. The final rate is risk-based and depends on business vintage, turnover, credit score and banking history. The exact rate, all fees and the total cost of the loan are shown in the Key Fact Statement (KFS) before you sign.

title: No Collateral Required
doc_title: Kosha Business Growth Loan
content: The Business Growth Loan does not require property, gold or any other collateral. A personal guarantee from the promoter or proprietor is required.

title: Uses of the Loan
doc_title: Kosha Business Growth Loan
content: Funds can be used for working capital, inventory purchase, equipment purchase, business expansion, and renovation of business premises. Funds cannot be used for speculative real estate, stock market trading, cryptocurrency trading, gambling, or repaying personal credit card debt.

title: Disbursal Timeline
doc_title: Kosha Business Growth Loan
content: After approval and signing of the loan agreement, disbursal typically happens within 3 working days. Approval is subject to credit assessment and is never guaranteed.

title: What documents do I need to apply
doc_title: Frequently Asked Questions - Business Loan
content: You need PAN and Aadhaar for KYC, the last 12 months of business bank statements, GST returns or ITR for the last 2 years, and business registration proof such as GST certificate, Udyam registration or shop and establishment licence.

title: Can I prepay or foreclose my loan
doc_title: Frequently Asked Questions - Business Loan
content: Yes. You can foreclose the loan after paying 6 EMIs. A foreclosure charge of 4% of the outstanding principal applies. Part-prepayment is allowed once a year up to 25% of the outstanding principal with a 2% charge on the prepaid amount.

title: What happens if I miss an EMI
doc_title: Frequently Asked Questions - Business Loan
content: A late payment charge of 2% per month is levied on the overdue instalment amount, plus a cheque or NACH bounce charge of Rs. 500 per instance. Missed monthly instalments are reported to credit bureaus and can lower your credit score.

title: How is my data used
doc_title: Frequently Asked Questions - Business Loan
content: Your documents are used only for KYC verification and credit assessment, stored in encrypted form, and shared only with credit bureaus and regulators as required by law. We never sell customer data.

title: Are there any hidden charges
doc_title: Frequently Asked Questions - Business Loan
content: No. Every applicable charge, including the processing fee, interest, foreclosure charge and late payment charge, is listed in the Key Fact Statement shared before you sign. The processing fee is up to 2% of the loan amount plus GST and is deducted from the disbursed amount.

title: I already have a loan with a bank. Can I still apply
doc_title: Frequently Asked Questions - Business Loan
content: Yes. An existing loan does not automatically disqualify you. Your existing EMIs are considered when assessing repayment capacity. Kosha Capital does not offer balance transfer or debt consolidation for business loans.

title: How can I speak to a person
doc_title: Frequently Asked Questions - Business Loan
content: A relationship manager can call you back within 1 business day. Callbacks are available Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM IST. You can also email support@kosha-demo.example.

title: Do I need a medical exam
doc_title: Lumina Life (DEMO) - Bank Referral Call Guide and FAQ
content: For coverage up to PHP 2,000,000 at age 45 and below, a health declaration is usually enough. Higher coverage or older applicants may need a medical exam at an accredited clinic, and Lumina Life pays for it.

title: How are claims paid
doc_title: Lumina Life (DEMO) - Bank Referral Call Guide and FAQ
content: Beneficiaries submit the claim form, death certificate and valid IDs at any Bangko Kapwa branch. Approved claims are paid within 10 working days after complete documents.

title: Contestability period
doc_title: Lumina Life (DEMO) - Bank Referral Call Guide and FAQ
content: For the first 2 years, Lumina Life may review a claim if information in the application was misrepresented. After 2 years the policy becomes incontestable except for fraud.

title: Mahal / too expensive
doc_title: Lumina Life (DEMO) - Bank Referral Call Guide and FAQ
content: Naiintindihan ko po, budget is important. Coverage can start at PHP 500,000 and the premium can be paid monthly through auto-debit. You can start with a lower sum assured and add riders later.

title: I already have an HMO
doc_title: Lumina Life (DEMO) - Bank Referral Call Guide and FAQ
content: An HMO pays hospital and medical bills while you are alive. Life insurance gives a cash benefit to your beneficiaries if you pass away. They serve different needs and work well together.

title: Is this a scam? / Trust concern
doc_title: Lumina Life (DEMO) - Bank Referral Call Guide and FAQ
content: The policy is issued by Lumina Life and sold only by licensed financial advisors at Bangko Kapwa. You can verify the advisor's license and visit any branch. You will never be asked to send money to a personal account.

title: I'm still young, I don't need it yet
doc_title: Lumina Life (DEMO) - Bank Referral Call Guide and FAQ
content: Premiums are lower while you are young and healthy, and the rate is locked for the term. Coverage also protects the people who depend on you, like your parents, spouse or children.

title: I need to think about it / Pag-iisipan ko muna
doc_title: Lumina Life (DEMO) - Bank Referral Call Guide and FAQ
content: Walang problema po, take your time. A licensed financial advisor can call you back at a time convenient for you.

title: Compliance rules
doc_title: Lumina Life (DEMO) - Bank Referral Call Guide and FAQ
content: The bot is not a licensed financial advisor and must say so if asked for personal financial advice. ; Premium amounts are illustrations; the final premium is subject to underwriting. ; Never say a claim is guaranteed to be paid. ; Offer a licensed financial advisor whenever the customer asks for a person.

title: Coverage
doc_title: Lumina Protect Plus - Term Life Insurance
content: Lumina Protect Plus is a term life insurance plan offered through Bangko Kapwa branches (bancassurance). Sum assured (coverage) ranges from PHP 500,000 to PHP 5,000,000. Entry age is 18 to 60 years old, and coverage continues until age 70.

title: Sample Premium
doc_title: Lumina Protect Plus - Term Life Insurance
content: For a 30-year-old non-smoker, coverage of PHP 1,000,000 costs about PHP 1,250 per month. This is an illustration only; the final premium depends on age, health declaration and underwriting.

title: Payment Modes
doc_title: Lumina Protect Plus - Term Life Insurance
content: Premiums can be paid monthly, quarterly, semi-annually or annually through auto-debit from a Bangko Kapwa savings account, over the counter at any Bangko Kapwa branch, or through the Lumina app.

title: Riders
doc_title: Lumina Protect Plus - Term Life Insurance
content: Optional riders: Accidental Death Benefit (doubles the payout for accidental death), Critical Illness rider (advance payout of up to 50% of the sum assured upon diagnosis of a covered critical illness), and Waiver of Premium (future premiums are waived if the policyholder becomes totally and permanently disabled).

title: Beneficiaries
doc_title: Lumina Protect Plus - Term Life Insurance
content: You can name up to 5 beneficiaries. Beneficiaries can be revocable (you may change them anytime) or irrevocable (changes require the beneficiary's written consent).

title: Grace Period and Lapse
doc_title: Lumina Protect Plus - Term Life Insurance
content: There is a 31-day grace period after the premium due date. If the premium is still unpaid after the grace period, the policy lapses and coverage stops. A lapsed policy can be reinstated within 2 years by paying the back premiums and submitting a health declaration.

title: Free Look Period
doc_title: Lumina Protect Plus - Term Life Insurance
content: You have 15 days from receipt of the policy to cancel it for a full refund of premiums paid, minus medical exam costs if any.
